rationale: Both round-7 R5 asks are addressed at reviewed commit 2e73a0f3. The elision protocol now chooses the admissible at-least-once contract, expressly withdraws the unprovable exactly-once claim, gives operation-specific idempotency/convergence arguments, completes the absent-to-D and both-elided transition routes, and adds the three requested interruption fixtures. The bead-6 ADR-0041 section 3 draft carries the same contract and graph. ADR-0030 conformance is now implementable as written: the plan names all seven required Executor methods, assigns thin gitutil wrappers to MindspecExecutor and stubs to MockExecutor, and explicitly prohibits a new internal/complete-to-gitutil import. The remaining R5 ADR lenses show no regression: the ADR-0041 section 1 amendment still reverses both load-bearing directions honestly, the ADR-0023 carve-out remains limited to pre-epic drafts, the ADR-0025 amendment remains limited to the worktree-creating next claim path, and ADR-0037 correctly remains untouched. Plan validation exits 0 with only the three acknowledged decomposition warnings. No defect remains that would corrupt a bead's implementation.
